We monitor your BMW’s needs – so you don’t have to.
Tackling mountain switchbacks, the last thing you should be thinking
about is the state of your brake pads. Thanks to BMW’s integrated on-
board diagnostics system, you’ll always know exactly when the next service
is due, and what work will be required. Condition Based Service (CBS)
measures the condition of key parts that are subject to wear and tear.
It also tracks fluid levels and monitors your BMW’s time- and mileage-
dependent service requirements. Using this data, the Info Display in the
cockpit automatically alerts you in advance whenever any part of your
vehicle will require servicing – so there are no surprises ahead.
